title: Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Add a Second Pricing Page
text:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Add a Second Pricing Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000009324
To create an additional pricing page that has a different side-by-side pricing table, than the one currently being used, here are the steps:

## 1. Clone The Side-By-Side Pricing Menu via the Menu Manager
See: How To Clone A Menu via the Menu Manger

## 2. Follow the Steps to Display the Side-by-Side Pricing Menu on a Web Page
See: How to Display Side-By-Side Pricing Tables On Web Pages
